title: KNICKS EXTENSION DEADLINE DAY! Hart $131M + August 11 KAT Bombshell! Knicks News Today
description:
The New York Knicks face MASSIVE extension deadlines today and tomorrow! Josh Hart becomes eligible for a 4-year, $131 million extension TODAY (August 10), and reports say he'll follow Jalen Brunson's blueprint with a team-friendly deal. But tomorrow (August 11) is the HIDDEN deadline for Karl-Anthony Towns and Deuce McBride — if the Knicks don't extend them by then, they preserve trade flexibility for February's deadline. KAT is eligible for $272M, Deuce for $95M. Will they sign? Plus: RIP Don Nelson, who coached the Knicks in 1995-96 and just passed at 86. We break down the second apron reality, the championship window, and how Leon Rose navigates the tightest cap situation in franchise history.
